sentences: At school we learn about Greece in *antiquity*.
Op school leren we over Griekenland en Rome in de *oudheid*.
Knights live in castles during *the Middle Ages*.
Ridders wonen in de *middeleeuwen* in kastelen.
In Florence, *the Renaissance* brings new ideas about art.

Gold decoration in churches is typical of *the Baroque*.
Rijke gouden versiering in kerken is typisch voor de *barok*.
The pink palace room has curves in *rococo* style.
De roze paleiskamer heeft zachte rondingen in *rococo*-stijl.
Tall white columns on banks come from *neoclassicism*.
Hoge witte zuilen op banken komen uit het *neoclassicisme*.

In *realism*, a painter shows tired workers.

Plain glass buildings are an example of *modernism*.

In *abstract art*, a painting may show only colors.

Every new idea in art starts with *the avant-garde*.

In *the Golden Age*, Dutch traders make Amsterdam rich.
Amsterdam wordt rijk door de handel in de *Gouden Eeuw*.
The *Gothic* church has tall windows and pointed towers.
De *gotische* kerk heeft hoge ramen en spitse torens.
My sister listens to *classical* music while she studies.
